Services

Three details. One clear price each.

Prices start at the amounts shown and depend on vehicle size: small, medium or large.

01

Standard Detail

Exterior hand wash, bugs removed, rims and tires deep cleaned, windows, door jambs, tire shine, vacuum and wipe down.

fromFrom $245 small · $275 medium · $299 large

02

Premium Detail

Everything in Standard, plus clay bar decontamination, a 6-month spray sealant, trim shine, steam-cleaned interior, and conditioned plastics and leathers.

fromFrom $375 small · $425 medium · $450 large

03

Ultimate Detail

Standard and Premium, plus a 1-step polish, engine bay cleaned and shined, and seats and carpets shampooed.

fromFrom $550 small · $600 medium · $650 large

04

RV Wash & Wax

A thorough clean for large vehicles that protects and brings out your RV's finish.

fromFrom $15 per linear foot

05

Exterior Detailing

Wheels to windows, polished and protected so the paint stands out.

06

Interior Detailing

Dashboard to carpets, refreshed with nothing left untouched.
